import json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals={v for row in g for v in row}
    # background = most common; sprite color(s) = rest
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if len(sc)!=1: return None
    c=sc[0]
    P={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c}
    if len(P)<2: return None
    # split into connected-ish copies: find two row-bands
    rows=sorted({i for i,j in P})
    # assume two copies separated by a gap of empty rows
    bands=[]; cur=[rows[0]]
    for r in rows[1:]:
        if r-cur[-1]>1: bands.append(cur); cur=[r]
        else: cur.append(r)
